clue.text: Veto decision thus?

parts.note: the letters of veto can be cast, rearranged, into vote; and a chair's deciding ballot that can block a motion is so named

explanation.surface: A question about how a veto gets decided.
explanation.walkthrough: Read cryptically, VETO 'cast' gives VOTE, while the whole phrase also names the chair's tie-breaking ballot.
explanation.definitionFit: The tie-breaking ballot of a chairperson decides the matter, and may block a proposal like a veto.

clue.text: Collusion — accountant sounds warning

parts.note: CA is short for chartered accountant
a car horn hoots to sound a warning

explanation.surface: An accountant blows the whistle on collusion.
explanation.walkthrough: CA (chartered accountant) is a British professional qualification.
explanation.definitionFit: To be 'in cahoots' is to be in secret partnership, so the word stands for conspiracy or collusion.

clue.text: None, oddly, found in Mediterranean plant

indicators.note: found in means the picked letters sit inside the sea word

parts.note: the Mediterranean is a sea

indicators.note: oddly means take the first, third and so on letters of the word None

explanation.surface: No such plant grows anywhere around the Mediterranean.
explanation.definitionFit: Senna is a shrub of the pea family, known for its laxative leaves and pods.

clue.text: Washed out and cross, losing time for golf

indicators.note: losing ... for says one letter is dropped and another put in its place

parts.note: cross means annoyed, irritated
G is golf in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone washed out and annoyed after giving up time on the golf course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing time for golf' swaps the T of IRRITATED for a G.
explanation.definitionFit: Land that has been irrigated has had water channelled over it, so it has been washed with water.

clue.text: Weapons offered comfortable returns

indicators.note: returns says the word for comfortable is read backwards

parts.note: snug means comfortable and cosy

explanation.surface: Weapons on offer bring a comfortable profit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returns' looks like profit but turns SNUG round.
explanation.definitionFit: Guns are firearms, the commonest kind of weapon.

clue.text: Sort of office represented in golf championship scheme?

parts.note: the Open is the British golf championship
a plan is a scheme

explanation.surface: An office layout drawn up at a golf tournament.
explanation.walkthrough: The Open is Britain's major golf championship.
explanation.definitionFit: An office with no internal walls, desks all in one big room, is described with this layout term.

clue.text: Longing for English beer with no top

indicators.note: with no top says the first letter of the beer word is removed

parts.note: lager is a type of beer

explanation.surface: Someone craving English beer that has lost its head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no top' removes the L of LAGER, the top of a down light.
explanation.definitionFit: To be keen and impatient for something is a state of longing for it.

clue.text: Outside area in which poor dunce's book's ending

indicators.note: poor signals that the letters of dunce are badly arranged
ending says take the last letter of the word book

explanation.surface: A struggling pupil's book ends with a scene on a ship's open area.
explanation.walkthrough: 'poor' rearranges DUNCE into SUNDEC; 'ending' adds the K of book.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship's or house's open deck for sunbathing is an outdoor area.

clue.text: Reversing Aussie utility vehicle into factory, becomes irritable

indicators.note: into says the turned word goes inside the factory word

parts.note: a plant is a factory

indicators.note: Reversing says the vehicle word is read backwards

parts.note: ute is Australian slang for a utility vehicle, a pick-up truck

explanation.surface: Someone backing a pick-up into a factory loses their temper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Aussie' flags Australian slang: a ute is a pick-up truck there; 'becomes' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone petulant is sulky and bad-tempered, quick to take offence.

clue.text: Name adopted by red China strangely becomes an obstacle

indicators.note: adopted by says one piece is taken inside the other
strangely says the letters of red China are rearranged

explanation.surface: A name taken up by Communist China becomes a stumbling block.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strangely' rearranges RED CHINA into HIDRANCE, and 'adopted by' puts N inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A hindrance is something that gets in the way, an impediment or barrier.

clue.text: Politician wanting information about boundaries of Rye

indicators.note: about says the information word goes around the other piece

parts.note: gen is slang for information

indicators.note: boundaries of says take the outside letters of Rye

explanation.surface: A politician wants to know about the town limits of Rye.
explanation.walkthrough: Rye is a small town in East Sussex, England.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of an environmentalist party is a politician of that colour.

clue.text: Colour of old cooker?

parts.note: a range is a large old-fashioned kitchen stove

explanation.surface: What colour was the old kitchen stove?
explanation.walkthrough: A range is a large kitchen stove, such as an Aga, common in British farmhouses.
explanation.definitionFit: Orange is the colour between red and yellow.

clue.text: Secret regularly concealed in a perfect opening

indicators.note: concealed in says the picked letters are hidden inside the other piece

parts.note: pure means perfect, flawless

indicators.note: regularly says take every other letter of the word Secret

explanation.surface: A secret is kept hidden within a perfect opening.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes the even letters of Secret, ERT.
explanation.definitionFit: An aperture is a gap or hole, such as a camera's lens opening.

clue.text: Leading actor pious man reviewed reacts in surprise

parts.note: the star of a show is its leading actor

indicators.note: reviewed says the abbreviation is read backwards

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for saint, a pious man

explanation.surface: A star and a holy man both react in surprise to a review.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reviewed' turns ST into TS.
explanation.definitionFit: To jump or flinch when startled is to give a start, so a verb for reacting with surprise.

clue.text: Growth of hypocrisy and end of faith in Australia

indicators.note: in says the pieces go inside the Australia abbreviation

parts.note: cant is hypocritical, pious talk

indicators.note: end of says take the last letter of faith

explanation.surface: A rise in hypocrisy marks the end of faith in Australia.
explanation.definitionFit: Acanthus is a plant, and a plant is something that grows.

clue.text: Ready to go after shopping?

parts.note: ready is slang for money, and a till service gives money for the customer to take away after buying goods

explanation.surface: Is the shopper ready to leave once the purchases are done?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ready' looks like an adjective but is the noun meaning cash.
explanation.definitionFit: A retailer lets a card payer withdraw money at the till, so the customer leaves with money after paying.

clue.text: Object of search for lost glory in winter fall

indicators.note: in says the rearranged letters go inside the icy weather word

parts.note: hail is ice falling from the sky in winter

indicators.note: lost says the letters of glory are scattered and rearranged

explanation.surface: A quest for glory that was lost in a winter storm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'winter fall' is weather, not a season's tumble; 'lost' is the anagram signal, not part of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The Grail sought by Arthurian knights is the classic object of a quest, and the phrase now means any sought-after prize.

clue.text: Seat reserved — take a chance on star

indicators.note: reserved is read as re-served, the letters of Seat served up again in a new order

parts.note: to risk something is to take a chance on it

explanation.surface: Booking a seat is a gamble on a star performer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reserved' is read as re-served, rearranging SEAT into ASTE.
explanation.definitionFit: This typographical mark is a small star shape.

clue.text: Exhibit new receiver given to supporter

parts.note: a bra is a supporting undergarment
a satellite dish is a signal receiver

explanation.surface: Showing off a new satellite dish fixed to a support.
explanation.walkthrough: 'supporter' looks like a fan but is a bra.
explanation.definitionFit: To brandish something is to wave it about for show, to display it.

clue.text: Act as bearers for shops

parts.note: to be something is to act as it
trays bear or carry things

explanation.surface: Acting as porters for stores.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shops' is the verb: to inform on someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To shop someone is British slang for informing on them, a betrayal.

clue.text: Make a mess of protecting student spot

indicators.note: protecting says the first piece goes around the student letter

parts.note: to botch is to make a mess of
L is learner, a student, from the L-plate

explanation.surface: A clumsy job leaving a mark on a student.
explanation.walkthrough: L stands for learner, from the L-plates on British learner drivers' cars.
explanation.definitionFit: A blotch is an irregular patch or mark, a spot or stain.

clue.text: Supply liquid, beating dry heat

indicators.note: beating says the letters of dry heat are battered into a new order

explanation.surface: Drink plenty to beat the dry heat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beating' rearranges DRY HEAT.
explanation.definitionFit: To hydrate is to give water to, supplying fluid to a body or substance.

clue.text: Decorated journalist attached to military display

indicators.note: attached to says the journalist piece is joined on after

parts.note: a tattoo is an evening military show of music and marching
ED is short for editor, a journalist

explanation.surface: A journalist honoured at a military pageant.
explanation.walkthrough: The Edinburgh Military Tattoo is the best-known such display.
explanation.definitionFit: Skin marked with inked designs has been decorated.

clue.text: Home games must include end of series

indicators.note: must include says the letters sit inside the words Home games

explanation.surface: Home games must feature at the end of the season.
explanation.definitionFit: The last letter of the Greek alphabet stands for the end of a sequence.

clue.text: Settled for a good source of venison on the way back

indicators.note: on the way back says the whole run of pieces is read backwards

parts.note: venison is the meat of a deer

explanation.surface: Content to settle for good venison on the trip home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the way back' turns A G DEER round as a whole.
explanation.definitionFit: A matter agreed on has been decided, settled by consent.

clue.text: Relaxed, wiped out with no end of war

indicators.note: with no says the following letter is taken away

parts.note: erased means wiped out

indicators.note: end of says take the last letter of war

explanation.surface: Relaxed now that the war has been wiped from memory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no end of war' drops the R from ERASED.
explanation.definitionFit: Tension that has lessened has eased off, become relaxed.

clue.text: Keen on independent books on love

parts.note: NT is the New Testament, books of the Bible
love is nil in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: An independent bookshop keen on romance.
explanation.definitionFit: Being into something is informal for being enthusiastic about it.

clue.text: Severe reduction in atomic energy

indicators.note: in says the reduction word goes inside the energy abbreviation

parts.note: AE is short for atomic energy
a cut is a reduction

explanation.surface: A drastic cutback in nuclear power.
explanation.definitionFit: A severe shortage or pain is an intense one, acute in degree.

clue.text: Marine area — one in Asia to be developed

indicators.note: to be developed says the letters of one in Asia are worked into a new form

explanation.surface: A single site in Asia awaiting development by the sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be developed' rearranges ONE IN ASIA.
explanation.definitionFit: This arm of the Mediterranean between Greece and Italy is a named stretch of sea.

clue.text: Admit the truth of learning on account

indicators.note: on says the learning piece follows the account piece

parts.note: knowledge is learning

explanation.surface: Concede the truth of what was learnt on the accounts.
explanation.definitionFit: To accept or recognise a fact openly is to admit it is true.
